wqbxg2wp.baseName: Christmas Tree World 9ft Pre-Lit Slim Wildhorn Pine - Warm White Lights
wqbxg2wp.variantName: Christmas Tree World 9ft Pre-Lit Slim Wildhorn Pine - Warm White Lights
wqbxg2wp.sourceDescription: Enjoy a festive glow with the 9ft Pre-lit Slim Wildhorn Pine. This elegant artificial Christmas tree combines lifelike pine needle foliage with 550 multi-function warm white LED lights in a slender shape, making it a lovely choice for rooms with high ceilings where floor space is limited. Featuring distinctive short-cut pine needle foliage, the Slim Wildhorn Pine has traditional PVC tips tucked towards the centre. These add depth and fullness, while the outer branches give a natural appearance. It offers a beautifully full look within a narrow silhouette. It has gently upswept branches and a slim, tapered shape, with natural green shades and subtle brown detailing. At 9ft tall, it brings impressive height to your festive display while leaving more room for your Christmas celebrations. Warm white LEDs highlight the needles, with multiple lighting effects to suit your display. The tree comes in four sections, with hinged branches for easy assembly and a supportive metal stand. Spread inner PVC tips before shaping the outer pine needle branches. Wear long sleeves and the included gloves when fluffing the prickly pine needles. Designed for indoor use only, with Christmas Tree World's 10-year foliage and branch guarantee and a 1-year guarantee on the lights. Please note: Accessories in the images are not included with purchase. Product Features • Size: 9ft • Pre-lit: 550 multi-function warm white LED lights • Number of branch tips: 1,383 • Foliage: Realistic pine needle outer branches with traditional PVC tips towards the centre for added fullness • Foliage colour: Natural green • Tree width: 105cm diameter • Easy assembly: Attached hinged branches and four tree sections • Base: Metal stand measuring 65cm in diameter • Includes gloves to wear during assembly • Indoor use only • Guarantee: 10 years on foliage and branches, plus 1 year on the lights • Supplied in one carton • Carton dimensions: 116cm × 34cm × 36cm • Weight: 17.00kg • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. Read the operating instructions before use. Keep away from heat sources. Christmas Tree World, Unit 3, Enfield Industrial Estate, Enfield Street, Wigan, Greater Manchester, WN5 8DB, United Kingdom
